intro.text: A Fused of the nex-im, able to travel as a ribbon of light, who claims the right to hunt down Kaladin.
A Fused of the nex-im, known as the Pursuer, whose tradition is to hunt down anyone who kills him.

items.text: Lezian was the first Fused ever killed by a human. To escape the shame, he hunted down his killer and slew him, beginning a tradition: whoever killed him, he would pursue until they died, and he never failed. When an Isolation came before he could finish, he killed himself rather than return to Braize unavenged.

Sent with Leshwi's Heavenly Ones to scout the Fourth Bridge and test a new fabrial at Hearthstone, Lezian found Kaladin and fought him in the air, jumping between bodies. When Kaladin began reading his jumps, Lezian seized hostages and retreated into the manor, daring Kaladin to follow.

Reborn, Lezian refused blame for the lost device before the Nine and claimed the right to pursue Kaladin. Leshwi challenged his sanity, and the Nine gave her a prior claim on Kaladin's life, so Lezian stormed out.

Lezian lent his troops to Raboniel for the invasion of Urithiru, broke Battalionlord Teofil's final stand by jumping along the line, and won leave to keep hunting Kaladin. He turned whole search parties toward Kaladin and later captured his family, until Leshwi took them into her custody.

Lezian twice waited in ambush at the nodes guarding the tower, nearly choking Kaladin and later sealing him inside a well, but Kaladin escaped both times. As Raboniel turned to her research, Lezian pushed his troops toward ever harsher treatment of the tower's humans.
At the last node Lezian fought Kaladin before a watching crowd, lost his nerve and fled. Shamed, he attacked again, but Kaladin bound his final body to the atrium window and lashed him apart.
When Lezian returned in a new body, El stabbed him with a knife carrying anti-Voidlight to test it, and the weapon destroyed him for good.

appearance.text: Easily seven feet tall, with jet-black skin marbled in red, glowing red eyes, dark red hair woven into his clothes and a jagged carapace with fin-like horns above his ears.

personality.text: Lezian prefers not to speak human languages, though he can. He prides himself on working his way into human stories each Return, and is respected for his determination but known as reckless.
His tradition of avenging his own deaths overrides reason; he does not care whether he kills his quarry in a fair fight or in their sleep, and calls himself a spren of vengeance.
